scope: Consolidate 13 discoverable OMEGA skills into one entry with 13 on-demand mode references; preserve functional CLI and workflow bodies

provenance.source_manifest_excludes: docs/evidence/* to avoid self-reference; ignored .omega/node_modules not published
provenance.freshness: Gate/scenario/comparison records bind this clean source commit and runtime. Adding this report changes workspace/HEAD; records become historical. Final publication gates are rerun on the report commit.
provenance.baseline_note: router-contract-v1 and v2 are different suites. Migration preserves workflow bodies and operational regressions, not a comparable native quality score. Evolution after migration uses a new v2 baseline.

counts.counting_rule: The skill benchmark repeats the full 204-test Python suite; do not add it to the unique test count. Native Node fixture has 1 pass/1 deliberate skip and repeats its test for regression. No native LLM quality evaluation.
